description: This source file implements core functionalities for the 'send-pack' operation in Git, including object packing, reference updates, handling push certificates, communication protocols with the remote, and negotiation procedures.

methods.description: Callback to advertise shallow grafts in shallow repositories.

methods.name: void advertise_shallow_grafts_buf(struct repository * r,struct strbuf * sb)
methods.description: Builds a buffer of shallow grafts information for shallow repositories.

methods.name: int check_to_send_update(const struct ref * ref,const struct send_pack_args * args)
methods.description: Determines if a ref should be sent to the remote, based on its status and push options.

methods.name: const char * next_line(const char * line,size_t len)
methods.description: Finds the beginning of the next line in a buffer.

methods.name: int generate_push_cert(struct strbuf * req_buf,const struct ref * remote_refs,struct send_pack_args * args,const char * cap_string,const char * push_cert_nonce)
methods.description: Generates a push certificate for secure push operations, signs it, and encodes the push info.

methods.name: void reject_invalid_nonce(const char * nonce,int len)
methods.description: Validates a nonce to ensure it contains only permitted characters.

methods.name: void get_commons_through_negotiation(struct repository * r,const char * url,const struct ref * remote_refs,struct oid_array * commons)
methods.description: Performs negotiation with the remote to determine common objects for efficient pushing.
